item.title: Attorneys discuss possible retrial date at Lindsay Clancy hearing
item.description: Lindsay Clancy was back in Plymouth Superior Court in Massachusetts for the first time since her murder trial ended in a mistrial.

item.title: Iran says it expects response to cease-fire plan already rejected by Trump
item.description: Trump says U.S. and Iranian negotiators are talking via mediators, but insists he has "offered them NOTHING" to get a peace deal done.

item.title: Senate approves sweeping college sports bill
item.description: The Senate approved the "Protect College Sports" bill late Monday night, meant to establish federal framework to regulate aspects of college sports like the transfer portal and name, image and likeness rights. Nikole Killion reports.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer suggests prosecutors didn't prove that she killed her children
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer, Kevin Reddington, is in court for a hearing on a potential new trial against the Massachusetts mother. Reddington suggested during the proceedings that prosecutors did not prove that Clancy actually committed the killings. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul reports.

item.title: Jack Smith's opening statement: "Trump engaged in serious crimes against our nation"
item.description: Former special counsel Jack Smith is testifying before the House Judiciary Committee about his investigations into President Trump. Here's his opening statement.

item.title: Hurricane Polo will impact the U.S. after slamming Mexico. See its path.
item.description: Hurricane Polo is expected to bring heavy rains and flooding to parts of the southwestern United States.

item.title: Details emerge in case of former Cornell student alleging rape by frat members
item.description: A woman, identified only as Jane Doe, alleges she was gang-raped by seven fraternity members in 2024 and accuses Cornell University of failing to protect her.

item.title: Severely disabled toddler euthanized in the Netherlands under new rules
item.description: Dutch doctors decided to euthanize a child just under the age of 2 under new rules allowing the procedure for children suffering unbearably.

item.title: How to manage changing family dynamics as your parents age
item.description: People are learning to navigate the changing dynamics of aging with their parents. CBS News' Arthur Brooks has some tips.

item.title: Migrant man died after fleeing ICE agents. His family explains what he was doing in the U.S.
item.description: A construction worker in Michigan died after crashing his car following a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement pursuit. CBS News' Camilo Montoya-Galvez spoke to the man's family.

item.title: Dutch National Police arrest member of group that claimed to have hacked FBI
item.description: About a week ago, the cybercriminal group ShinyHunters claimed it had defaced the FBI's jobs website and bragged that it had stolen data about FBI personnel and job applicants.

item.title: Bestselling author John Grisham reworked the first sentence of "The French Illusion" for six months
item.description: Author John Grisham has published over 50 bestselling books. Now, Grisham is breaking into the spy genre with "The French Illusion," which tells the story of a newlywed couple kidnapped in Paris. Grisham joins "CBS Mornings" with more.

item.title: Blu DeTiger talks ping-pong at the club and playing with Jack Antonoff on "Saturday Night Live"
item.description: Emerging musician and DJ Blu DeTiger started on TikTok and moved on to share the stage with Sabrina Carpenter, Sombr and others. She spoke with "CBS Mornings" about her music, including her upcoming album, "N.Y. Baby."

item.title: Artist whose song is featured in Trump ad sends cease-and-desist order
item.description: Attorneys for JMSN say the use of the song is a violation of federal copyright law and demand the ad be withdrawn.

item.title: Trump says he's surprised after U.K. releases 5 suspects on bail following apparent terror plot
item.description: President Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio are reacting to news that officials in the U.K. released five men suspected of plotting a terror attack near an air force base. CBS News' Ramy Inocencio reports.

item.title: CNN, Politico, MS NOW ask court to keep blocking Trump's press ban against them
item.description: CNN, MS NOW and Politico journalists, who were banned by Trump from White House grounds​ this month, asked a federal court to block the press ban until the case is resolved.

item.title: New text messages from days after alleged gang rape at Cornell University
item.description: CBS News New York has exclusively obtained screenshots from a source presented as text messages between Jane Doe and one of the defendants in a lawsuit alleging rape at a fraternity house at Cornell University in 2024.

item.title: Republican and Democratic Senators pass bill to overhaul college sports industry
item.description: A bipartisan effort to overhaul the college sports industry passed in the Senate. CBS News' Nikole Killion reports.

item.title: Finding meaning in caring for an aging parent
item.description: "The Free Press" columnist Arthur Brooks argues that caring for an aging parent doesn't have to be a burden. "The Free Press" is owned by CBS News' parent company Paramount Skydance.

item.title: Why Trump, Johnson and AI leaders are meeting at the White House
item.description: President Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson are meeting with AI leaders to discuss the technology and potential safety guardrails. CBS News' Ed O'Keefe reports.

item.title: Tips to save as holiday travel costs soar
item.description: With fall and winter holidays just around the corner, many Americans are looking at rising flight prices with hesitation. Kris Van Cleave has more.

item.title: U.S. ban on almost $1 billion in Canadian imports takes effect
item.description: The United States has banned nearly $1 billion worth of Canadian imports, including alcoholic beverages, dairy products and motorcycles.

item.title: Trump's ban on these Canadian goods is now in effect
item.description: President Trump's ban on certain goods from Canada is now in effect. CBS News' Javier E. David breaks down the details.

item.title: ICE wasted millions in rapid push to expand detention capacity, watchdog finds
item.description: With an unprecedented budget, ICE spent billions in a rush to expand its detention network, wasting millions in the process, the Government Accountability Office found.

item.title: Hurricane Polo makes landfall in Mexico
item.description: Hurricane Polo made landfall in Baja California Sur, Mexico, bringing "damaging winds and life-threatening flash flooding," and is expected hit the Southwest U.S. with heavy rain and flooding.

item.title: OpenAI halts model release over safety concerns: "Didn't quite meet the bar"
item.description: OpenAI said it has chosen not to release its new GPT-6.1 Astra model due to concerns about safety, as industry leaders warn of the risks posed by ever-more-powerful AI technology.

item.title: Holiday airfares soar to 10-year high. Here's how to save on flights.
item.description: Airfares for round-trip U.S. flights have jumped 31% compared to the same period last year, and tickets are likely to get pricier, according to a new analysis.

item.title: New York Times exec dies in California shooting; elderly in-laws accused of murder
item.description: An elderly couple in the San Francisco Bay Area is suspected of shooting and killing their son-in-law in the parking lot of a community park over the weekend.

item.title: Gas prices could soar if the U.S. bans diesel exports, economists say
item.description: President Trump said he is "very seriously" considering a ban on diesel exports. But such a move could drive U.S. gas prices sharply higher, analysts said.

item.title: Trump administration rolls back Biden-era fuel economy standards
item.description: Regulators estimate the new rule will result in an average of 34.9 miles per gallon by model year 2031, down from an earlier projection of 50.4 mpg.
